# hand-written settings
config_version = 1

[appearance]
theme = "kim-light"   # easier in daylight
font_size = 16
future_knob = "kept"

[terminal]
default_profile = "PowerShell"

[[profiles]]
name = "PowerShell"
program = "powershell.exe"
args = ["-NoLogo", "-NoProfile"]
env = { RUST_BACKTRACE = "1" }

[[profiles]]
name = "dev"
program = "cmd.exe"
args = ["/k"]
env = { MODE = "fast", GITHUB_TOKEN = "***" }

warnings: 1 secret-looking value(s) were replaced by ***; secrets do not belong in config.toml
